title: Governance Document Metadata v1
description: Flat machine-readable metadata convention for governance documents. Every document that carries governance weight must declare metadata conforming to this schema.

document_id.description: Unique stable identifier for this document version.

governance_kind.description: Primary governance kind of this document.

version.description: Semantic or calendar version of this document.

owner.description: Role or entity responsible for this document.

scope.description: Domain of applicability for this document's authority.

applies_to.description: Artifacts, roles, or components this document governs.

overrideability.description: How this document's rules may be constrained by narrower scopes.

canonical_for.description: Topics for which this document provides canonical authority. Each topic must be unique.

supersedes.description: Versioned document_id references that this document supersedes. Must not contain its own document_id. Must form a directed acyclic graph.

description.description: Human-readable summary of this document's purpose.

allOf.description: Guide documents must have informational authority and overrideability.
When overrideability is informational, authority_level must be informational.
Non-informational documents must declare canonical ownership via canonical_for.
Informational documents must not claim canonical authority.

$comment: Semantic constraints: supersedes must not contain the document's own document_id, and canonical_for must only appear on non-informational documents. Validation of self-reference and conditional constraints requires external enforcement as JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 cannot express all field-value relationship rules.
